claim: Parameter growth expands RID decimal precision depth of one normalized identity space; it does not require a separate giant floating-point object per identity in the conventional weight sense.

decimal_address_space.rule: d decimal places yield 10^d - 1 unique nonzero values in (0,1) at that quantization

uniqueness: No two parameters share the same RID-normalized probability identity at the active precision depth.

contrast.conventional: Distribute an answer across billions of learned floating-point weights and reconstruct it probabilistically.
contrast.viv: Normalize every possibility into a unique RID coordinate; locate the answer region from deterministic UML; use probability only to select the route through that space.

division_of_labor.UML: tokenizer — controls token identity, encode/decode, sealed destinations
division_of_labor.RID: stability — system/training health fold, residual into PID, halt/cool-down

expert_link: A/S/M/D experts examine the encoded equation and identify which domain or federation provides the most efficient route to the already located answer — they do not independently guess the destination.
evidence_status: doctrine_plus_combinatorial_selftest; not yet proved as full trillion-parameter plant implementation
